mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the cleaned address against the handset was most worthwhile: it resolved the immediate mystery while opening a larger question about who controls the directory.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two premature trolley combinations were a little repetitive, though the automatic compatibility feedback kept the repair moving.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the handset read the address correctly yet rejected it because the destination was missing from the active directory.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt entirely purposeless, though needing to free the caster before installing the replacement was not obvious from the initial board.

continue.text: Yes. The conflicting records and approaching directory migration make me curious how the neighborhood can challenge the system, and the physical repair grounded the story.
